claims.statement: Cedar Bluff Logistics Center has the largest building area among the comparable properties, at 412,000 square feet, exceeding all other comps in the set such as Fenwick Distribution Hub (356,800 SF) and Thornfield Industrial Park (289,500 SF).

citations.quote: Cedar Bluff Logistics Center, the largest asset in the comparable set at 412,000 square feet, closed in May 2025
